frame: x east, y north, cm, z up
collision_note: 'complex' = use complex collision as simple on that batch (stair treads, stoops, balcony decks, rear gallery decks and rear stair treads), as the existing *_Collision batches do; skins, fences, sheds and plants are NoCollision.
attribution: Ville de Montréal, données ouvertes (CC BY 4.0): Bâtiments 3D 2016 LOD2 heights; Unités d'évaluation foncière (year built, storeys) joined by address
limits: Footprints, street edges, storeys and construction years are data-driven where available. Brick colours, trim colours, door and window rhythm, stair shape and cornice details are rule-and-seed estimates after the Plateau heritage sheets, not surveys of individual buildings. Rear galleries, stairs, fences, gates, sheds and plants are rule-and-seed estimates too; lot lines are not mapped, so the rear lot line is taken at the ruelle or halfway to the next building.
